items.headline: Hayes throws 4 TD passes, Singleton catches 3 of them, and Tulsa routs Charlotte 42-14
items.description: — Baylor Hayes threw four touchdown passes, three of them to Oran Singleton Jr., and Tulsa blew past Charlotte 42-14 on Saturday.

items.headline: Ashton Gray scores twice as East Carolina outlasts Charlotte 17-16 to become bowl eligible again
items.description: — Ashton Gray rushed for two touchdowns, and East Carolina held on to beat Charlotte 17-16 on Saturday for the Pirates' third straight win and their third consecutive season of bowl eligibility.
